items.q: Circuit breaker tripped
items.a:
Locate the breaker panel in the downstairs bedroom behind the skiing picture. The picture frame is on a hinge. Just pull it open to reveal the panel.
Reset the tripped breaker by flipping it all the way to OFF and then back to ON.

items.q: Hot tub too hot or too cold
items.a:
Turn the hot tub temperature up or down using the control panel on the side of the tub. The temperature will adjust gradually over 30–60 minutes.
If it is in ECO mode, the temperature will not adjust. Press the ECO button to turn it off.

items.q: How do I change the thermostat temperature?
items.a:
Our home is equipped with a furnace for heating and an air conditioner for cooling.
The thermostat is located in the hallway near the kitchen.
Rotate the dial to adjust the temperature.
You can change the mode from heating to cooling by pressing down on the dial and rotating to the desired mode.

items.q: BBQ grill not working
items.a:
Open the cabinet under the grill and ensure that the propane tank valve is fully open.
If the grill still doesn't light, check that the igniter button is working. If not, use a long lighter to ignite the burners.
If the propane tank is empty, there is a spare tank in the garage. Please return the empty tank to the garage when you leave.

items.q: How do I use the dishwasher?
items.a:
Dishwasher detergent tabs are located under the sink. Use one tab per load.
Load dishes and press the start button. Close the door and the dishwasher will start automatically.
It's much easier to load heavy items toward the back.

If Alexa won't turn on or off the lights, try the wall switch.
If that doesn't work, you may need to reset the smart light by switching the circuit breaker off and on again. The breaker panel is in the downstairs bedroom behind the skiing picture.

items.q: How do I do laundry?
items.a:
All laundry supplies are provided in the laundry room. Detergent, fabric softener, and dryer sheets are all included.
Just turn on the washer or dryer and select your desired cycle then hold down the start button for 3 seconds to start the cycle.

items.q: Hot tub is dirty or has a strange smell
items.a:
Take a photo of the water and send it to us. We'll contact our maintenance team to check the water chemistry and make sure it's safe to use.
Do not use the hot tub if the water is cloudy, has a strong chemical smell, or has visible debris.
PLEASE don't pee in the hot tub. It can cause the water chemistry to go out of balance and make it unsafe to use.

items.q: WiFi not connecting
items.a:
Network name: Eaglewood Escape Guest
See the note on the wall in the kitchen.
If issues persist, try restarting your device or forgetting the network and reconnecting.
If it still doesn't connect, try restarting the router. The router is located in the cabinet under the TV in the living room. Unplug the power, wait 30 seconds, and plug it back in.
If issues persist, text or call Blake and we'll get you back online as soon as we are able.

items.q: Hot tub not heating
items.a:
Ensure the cover is fully closed — the tub won't heat efficiently with the cover open.
Check that the jets are off and the temperature is set to your desired level on the panel.
Heating can take 30–60 minutes after the cover has been open for a while.
Contact us if the temperature doesn't rise after an hour.

items.q: TV or streaming not working
items.a:
All TVs are logged into Netflix and Prime Video — just select the app and pick a profile.
If you log into a service with your own account, please log out before you leave.
You can also use Airplay to stream from your phone or tablet to the TV.
We do not provide cable or satellite TV service, but you can use streaming services like Hulu, Disney+, and YouTube TV with your own accounts.

activities.title: Electric Bike Tour of Bend & Deschutes River
activities.imageAlt: An electric bicycle and another rider in a bike lane in Bend
activities.description: Explore Bend and the Deschutes River with ease on a guided e-bike tour. With an electric bike to assist, you can go farther and see more while learning local history and stopping for refreshments.
activities.tip: Includes e-bike and helmet; wear closed-toe shoes.

activities.title: Ride the River Guided E-Bike Tour of Bend
activities.imageAlt: Riders on e-bikes following a river path
activities.description: A relaxed guided e-bike ride focusing on Bend's riverfront, Old Mill District, and neighborhood highlights — great for visitors who want a local introduction.
activities.tip: Smaller groups sell out on weekends; book ahead.

activities.title: Deschutes River E-Bike Tour
activities.imageAlt: E-bike parked near a river bank
activities.description: A shorter e-bike experience focused on scenic stretches of the Deschutes River and nearby attractions — ideal for casual riders.
activities.tip: Bring a water bottle and camera for river views.

activities.title: Cascade Lakes Kayak Tour
activities.imageAlt: Kayaks on a calm mountain lake
activities.description: Guided kayak tours among the Cascade Lakes — stunning alpine scenery and calm water paddling. Some itineraries include multiple lakes and shore snacks.
activities.tip: Dress in layers; water can be chilly even on warm days.

activities.title: 2-Hour High Cascades Scenic ATV Tour
activities.imageAlt: ATV riding on volcanic terrain
activities.description: Off-road ATV rides through High Cascades terrain — fast-paced, scenic fun with guided instruction and safety gear provided.
activities.tip: Closed-toe shoes required; bring sun protection and gloves if you have them.

activities.title: Deschutes River Horse Ride
activities.imageAlt: Horseback rider trotting along a riverside trail
activities.description: Guided horseback rides along the Deschutes River corridor — serene river views and a relaxed pace suitable for most riders.
activities.tip: Wear long pants and closed-toe shoes; bring a camera for riverside views.

activities.title: Cascade Lakes Moonlight & Starlight Canoe Tour
activities.imageAlt: Canoes on a lake at night under a starry sky
activities.description: A guided evening canoe tour under the stars — magical moonlit paddling with storytelling and light refreshments.
activities.tip: Check moon phase and weather; tours run on calm nights.

activities.title: Guided Lava Tube Cave Tour
activities.imageAlt: Inside a lava tube cave with a guided group
activities.description: Naturalist-led exploration of local lava tubes — learn volcanic geology and see dramatic subterranean formations. Guides provide lights and helmets.
activities.tip: Wear warm layers and sturdy shoes; tours often require bending and uneven footing.

activities.title: Limited-Entry Lava Tube Cave Tour
activities.imageAlt: Tour group inside a narrow lava tube
activities.description: Smaller-group or limited-access lava tube experiences — often include expert-led interpretation and quieter cave sections.
activities.tip: Limited-entry tours may require advance booking and have minimum fitness levels.

activities.title: Alpaca Picnic Experience
activities.imageAlt: Picnic with alpacas in a meadow
activities.description: Meet alpacas and enjoy a guided outdoor picnic — a family-friendly experience combining animal encounter and local snacks.
activities.tip: Perfect for kids and small groups — book for a private time slot.

activities.title: Chocolate Tour (Hot Chocolate & Samples)
activities.imageAlt: Assorted chocolates and hot chocolate cups
activities.description: A tasty guided walk sampling chocolate, hot cocoa, and paired treats at local shops — a sweet local introduction.
activities.tip: Great as a half-day indulgence — bring comfortable shoes.

activities.title: Food Truck & Brewery Tour (Complimentary Tastings)
activities.imageAlt: Assortment of food truck dishes and craft beer
activities.description: A guided tasting tour pairing Bend's food-truck scene with local breweries — small-group format with curated tastings.
activities.tip: Designated driver or transportation recommended when sampling beers.

activities.title: Craft Brewery Tour with Tastings
activities.imageAlt: Tasting flight of craft beers
activities.description: A curated brewery crawl showcasing Bend's best craft beer scene with guided tastings and behind-the-scenes insights.
activities.tip: Bring ID; tours often include transportation between stops.

activities.title: Ultimate Scavenger Bend (Downtown)
activities.imageAlt: Group solving clues in a downtown setting
activities.description: A playful city-wide scavenger hunt exploring downtown Bend's history, public art, and hidden gems — great for groups.
activities.tip: Works well for team outings or family groups; wear comfortable shoes.

activities.title: Central Oregon Night Sky Photo Tour
activities.imageAlt: Starry Milky Way over a mountain silhouette
activities.description: A guided astrophotography outing to prime dark-sky locations with instruction on long-exposure techniques — capture the Milky Way over the Cascades.
activities.tip: Bring a tripod and spare batteries; instructors often provide remote triggers.

activities.title: Personal Photography Tutoring in Bend
activities.imageAlt: Photographer leading a tutoring session outdoors
activities.description: One-on-one or small-group photography tutoring focused on composition, camera settings, and local shooting locations.
activities.tip: Share your gear and learning goals when booking for a tailored session.

activities.title: Private Bend Street Photo Tours
activities.imageAlt: Photographer shooting in an urban streetscape
activities.description: Private guided street photography tours through Bend's most photogenic neighborhoods and the Old Mill District — great for aspiring photographers and visitors who want curated shots.
activities.tip: Book a morning slot for softer light and fewer people.

activities.title: Small-Group Paddle Board & Happy Hour — Cascade Lakes
activities.imageAlt: Paddle boards lined up on a lake shore
activities.description: Paddle boarding on calm waters followed by a lakeside happy hour — a relaxed small-group outing on the Cascade Lakes.
activities.tip: Bring swimwear and a towel; tours often include light snacks.

activities.title: Murder Mystery Detective Experience
activities.imageAlt: Clues and map on a table for a detective game
activities.description: An interactive city-based murder-mystery experience — team up, solve clues, and explore Bend in a playful way.
activities.tip: Fun for groups — good for rainy-day entertainment.

activities.title: Hot Lava Bakery
activities.imageAlt: Fresh pastries and croissants in a bakery display
activities.description: Fresh pastries, croissants, and coffee in Sunriver Village — a local favorite for breakfast and take-away treats.
activities.distance: 5 min by bike to the Village
activities.tip: Arrive before 9:30 AM in peak season.

activities.title: Sparrow Bakery
activities.imageAlt: Fresh baked goods on a counter
activities.description: Bend's cult-favorite bakery famous for the ocean roll — a buttery, salted-sweet masterpiece. Also excellent savory pastries and coffee.
activities.tip: Ocean rolls sell out — go early or pre-order.

activities.title: Rio Sol at Sunriver Marina
activities.imageAlt: Outdoor dining with river views at sunset
activities.description: Latin American cuisine and craft cocktails on the Deschutes River at the Sunriver Marina. Scenic sunset dinners with water views.
activities.tip: Request a patio table for golden-hour views.

activities.title: El Caporal
activities.imageAlt: Mexican dish with tortillas and salsa
activities.description: Authentic Mexican cuisine with lively margaritas and a warm Village atmosphere.
activities.distance: 5 min by bike to the Village
activities.tip: Try the carne asada tacos and house margaritas.

activities.title: Blondie's Pizza
activities.imageAlt: Wood-fired pizza fresh from the oven
activities.description: Wood-fired, family-friendly pizza in Sunriver — great for groups and takeout.
activities.tip: Order ahead on busy summer nights.

activities.title: Village Bar & Grill
activities.imageAlt: Bar and grill dining area with rustic decor
activities.description: Casual American fare, cocktails, and a friendly local vibe right in the Village.
activities.tip: Good spot for families and late-night bites.

activities.title: The Wallow
activities.imageAlt: Elegant plated entree on a table
activities.description: Contemporary Pacific Northwest dishes with seasonal ingredients and a refined yet relaxed dining room.
activities.tip: Excellent for date nights and special occasions.

activities.title: Campfire Cucina
activities.imageAlt: Pasta and Italian dishes on a wooden table
activities.description: Italian-inspired cooking with wood-fired flavors — pizza, pasta, and shareable small plates.
activities.tip: Great for groups — try a few small plates to share.

activities.title: Century Common Taps & Trucks
activities.imageAlt: Outdoor food trucks and beer taps
activities.description: A rotating lineup of food trucks paired with local craft taps — casual outdoor dining and community vibes.
activities.tip: Check the events calendar for truck lineups and tap takeovers.

activities.title: Josie K's Deli
activities.imageAlt: Deli sandwich on a plate
activities.description: Casual deli fare with hearty sandwiches, salads, and quick grab-and-go options for day trips.
activities.tip: Perfect for picnic boxes and quick lunches.

activities.title: Benham Falls
activities.imageAlt: Waterfall cascading through a forest canyon
activities.description: The largest waterfall on the upper Deschutes River, thundering through a rugged lava canyon. Mostly flat, family-friendly, and beautiful year-round.
activities.tip: Combine with a bike ride on the Deschutes River Trail.
activities.seasonLabel: Best in spring for peak flow
activities.gettingThere: Short drive or bike ride from Sunriver. Trailhead parking off Forest Road 41.

activities.title: Deschutes River Trail
activities.imageAlt: Dirt trail beside the Deschutes River on the way to Benham Falls
activities.description: Paved and dirt paths following the Deschutes River through pine forest. Walk or bike from Sunriver toward Benham Falls.
activities.tip: Flat and scenic — perfect for an evening stroll.
activities.gettingThere: Access from multiple points in Sunriver — ask us for the closest trailhead.

activities.title: Smith Rock State Park
activities.imageAlt: Dramatic rocky cliffs and river canyon
activities.description: Oregon's most iconic crags — golden cliffs rising above the Crooked River. Misery Ridge is the classic loop with jaw-dropping views. Also world-class rock climbing.
activities.tip: Start early — the trail gets hot and crowded by midday in summer.

activities.title: Green Lakes Trail
activities.imageAlt: Alpine lake surrounded by mountain peaks
activities.description: A Central Oregon classic — hike through wildflower meadows and lava fields to impossibly blue alpine lakes beneath the South Sister volcano.
activities.tip: Arrive before 7 AM on weekends — the trailhead fills fast. Start early and bring layers — elevation gain and afternoon storms are real.
activities.gettingThere: 45 min drive to trailhead off Cascade Lakes Highway.

activities.title: Todd Lake Loop
activities.imageAlt: Todd Lake with Mount Bachelor behind it in the Deschutes National Forest
activities.description: Alpine lake loop at 6,500 ft with wildflowers in summer and Mt. Bachelor views. Cool escape on hot days.
activities.tip: Arrive early — small parking lot fills quickly on weekends.
activities.gettingThere: 25 min drive up Cascade Lakes Highway from Mt. Bachelor turnoff.

imageCredit.author: U.S. Forest Service, Pacific Northwest Region

activities.title: Tam McArthur Rim
activities.imageAlt: Mountain ridge trail with panoramic views
activities.description: A relatively short hike with enormous payoff — stand on the rim of a glacial cirque with views of Broken Top, the Three Sisters, and endless Cascades.
activities.tip: Wildflowers peak in July. Bring layers — it's exposed at the top.

activities.title: Tumalo Falls
activities.imageAlt: Tall waterfall in a lush forest
activities.description: A 97-foot waterfall just outside Bend with a scenic loop trail above the falls. Easy access and one of the most photographed spots in Central Oregon.
activities.tip: The upper trail gives you views most visitors miss.
activities.seasonLabel: Year-round — check road access in winter

activities.title: Lava Butte & Lava Lands
activities.imageAlt: Lava Butte cinder cone with volcanic landscape
activities.description: Climb a cinder cone for 360° views of volcanic landscape, then walk the paved Lava Lands loop through jagged black lava fields. Great for all ages.
activities.tip: Timed entry may be required in summer — check recreation.gov. Combine with the Lava River Cave or Lava Cast Forest for a full volcanic day.
activities.trailDistance: Lava Butte 1.5 miles round trip; Lava Lands Trail 0.5 miles
activities.gettingThere: 10 min drive to Lava Lands Visitor Center. May require a timed entry pass in summer.

activities.title: SHARC Aquatic Center
activities.imageAlt: Outdoor swimming pool with water slides
activities.description: Sunriver's premier aquatic center — waterslides, lazy river, lap pool, surf simulator, rock climbing wall, and fitness center. Your stay includes 8 guest passes.
activities.tip: Passes are in the kitchen drawer at the house.

activities.title: Elk Lake
activities.imageAlt: Clear alpine lake with pine trees and mountains
activities.description: A gorgeous alpine lake at 4,900 ft with sandy beaches, paddle rentals, and Mt. Bachelor as a backdrop. The water is cold but refreshing on hot summer days.
activities.tip: Grab lunch at the Elk Lake Resort cafe on the shore.

activities.title: Sparks Lake
activities.imageAlt: Serene lake reflecting mountain peaks at sunrise
activities.description: One of the most photographed lakes in Oregon — shallow, crystal-clear water with South Sister reflected on calm mornings. Wade in from the shore or bring a float.
activities.tip: Sunrise here is magical — bring a camera.

activities.title: Paulina Lake
activities.imageAlt: Mountain lake with forest shoreline
activities.description: A deep volcanic lake inside the Newberry Caldera with hot springs on the far shore, boat rentals, and excellent fishing. Two lakes in one caldera — East Lake is nearby.
activities.tip: Hike to Paulina Peak for a caldera overview before swimming.

activities.title: Devil's Lake
activities.imageAlt: Alpine lake surrounded by forested mountains
activities.description: A pristine alpine lake tucked in a glacial cirque with stunning mountain views and excellent swimming. Crystal-clear water and a scenic trail loop make it a must-visit destination.
activities.tip: Arrive early — parking fills quickly on weekends.

activities.title: Eaglewood Community Pool
activities.imageAlt: Community swimming pool on a sunny day
activities.description: Steps from the back deck — a seasonal community pool exclusive to Eaglewood guests and residents. Perfect for a quick dip without leaving the neighborhood.
activities.tip: Check the HOA board by the pool for seasonal hours.

activities.title: Deschutes River Float
activities.imageAlt: Kayaking on a calm river through forest
activities.description: The quintessential Central Oregon summer experience — float the gentle Deschutes on a tube or kayak through pine forests. Popular routes run from Sunriver toward Bend.
activities.tip: Rent tubes at the Sunriver Marina (three-mile float from Harper Bridge, June–August) or in Bend. Bring sunscreen and a dry bag.

activities.title: Sun Country Tours Whitewater
activities.imageAlt: Whitewater raft navigating river rapids
activities.description: Guided rafting trips on the Deschutes — from mellow scenic floats to Class III rapids through Big Eddy. Professional guides, all gear included.
activities.distance: Pickup in Bend or Sunriver area
activities.tip: Book the Big Eddy Thriller for families with teens.

activities.title: Big Eddy Thriller
activities.imageAlt: Raft going through whitewater rapids
activities.description: The Deschutes' most famous whitewater stretch — Class III rapids through a scenic canyon. Half-day guided trips suitable for adventurous beginners.
activities.tip: Wear a swimsuit under the wetsuit — you'll get soaked.

activities.title: Deschutes River SUP & Kayak
activities.imageAlt: Stand-up paddleboarding on a calm lake
activities.description: Calmer sections of the Deschutes near Sunriver are perfect for stand-up paddleboarding and kayak exploring. Several outfitters rent gear by the half-day.
activities.tip: Morning water is glassy — best for SUP.

activities.title: Mt. Bachelor Ski Resort
activities.imageAlt: Skier carving down a snowy mountain slope
activities.description: 3,365 acres of lift-served terrain on a single volcano — groomers, bowls, glades, and a legendary spring skiing season that runs into May. 24 minutes from the house.
activities.tip: Buy lift tickets online in advance during peak weeks.

activities.title: Mt. Bachelor Nordic Center
activities.imageAlt: Cross-country skier on a snowy forest trail
activities.description: 56 km of groomed cross-country trails through snow-covered forests at the base of the volcano. Rentals and lessons available for all skill levels.
activities.tip: The Twilight Trail is magical under the lights.

activities.title: Hoodoo Ski Area
activities.imageAlt: Snowboarder on a mountain with pine trees
activities.description: A fun, family-friendly ski area on Santiam Pass with night skiing, affordable tickets, and a laid-back vibe. Smaller than Bachelor but less crowded.
activities.tip: Night skiing on weekends is a unique experience.

activities.title: Mt. Bachelor Scenic Chairlift
activities.imageAlt: Mountain summit view above the clouds
activities.description: Not just for winter — ride the Pine Marten lift in summer for hiking, mountain biking, and panoramic views from 9,000 ft. Cool escape on hot days.
activities.tip: Bring a jacket — it's 20° cooler at the top.

activities.title: Phil's Trail Complex
activities.imageAlt: Mountain biker on a forest trail
activities.description: Bend's most beloved trail network — flowing singletrack through ponderosa pine with options from mellow to technical. Dozens of interconnected loops.
activities.tip: Start with 'Phil's Trail' proper — the original and still the best intro.

activities.title: Wanoga Snow Park Trails
activities.imageAlt: Mountain biker riding through a pine forest
activities.description: In winter, this sno-park transforms into fat-bike and cross-country ski terrain. In summer, nearby trails like Swampy Lakes offer high-elevation riding.
activities.tip: Check Trailforks for current trail conditions before heading out.

activities.title: Mt. Bachelor Bike Park
activities.imageAlt: Downhill mountain biker on a forest trail
activities.description: Lift-served downhill mountain biking in summer — no pedaling uphill required. Trails from green to double-black with full-suspension rentals at the base.
activities.tip: Rent a downhill bike at the base — it's worth it.

activities.title: Sunriver Paved Path Network
activities.imageAlt: Family biking on a paved path through trees
activities.description: 34+ miles of car-free paved paths through Sunriver — perfect for family rides. Grab a bike from our garage and explore the river, Village, and golf courses.
activities.tip: Ride to the Village for breakfast, then loop back via the river trail.

activities.title: Tiddlywinks & Forest Service Trails
activities.imageAlt: Mountain biker navigating a berm on a flow trail
activities.description: Playful, berm-filled flow trails near Bend that feel like a roller coaster on two wheels. Popular with intermediate riders looking for fun, not suffering.
activities.tip: Ride mid-week to avoid crowds.

activities.title: Crater Lake National Park
activities.imageAlt: Crater Lake with deep blue water and volcanic rim
activities.description: The deepest lake in the US, filling a collapsed volcano caldera with impossibly blue water. Rim Drive, boat tours to Wizard Island, and hikes for every ability.
activities.tip: Enter from the north entrance for the shortest drive from Sunriver.

activities.title: Lava River Cave
activities.imageAlt: Dark cave tunnel with light at the end
activities.description: Explore a mile-long lava tube — bring flashlights and warm layers for this underground adventure. One of the longest lava tubes in Oregon.
activities.tip: Rent lanterns at the entrance — phone flashlights aren't enough.

activities.title: High Desert Museum
activities.imageAlt: Natural history museum exhibit with wildlife
activities.description: World-class museum blending live wildlife, Oregon history, and art. Otters, raptors, a 1904 homestead, and immersive exhibits — great for rainy days or mid-day heat.
activities.tip: Allow at least 3 hours — there's a lot to see.

activities.title: Newberry National Volcanic Monument
activities.imageAlt: Volcanic landscape with lake and forest
activities.description: A massive shield volcano with obsidian flows, Paulina Falls, hot springs, and two crater lakes. Central Oregon's volcanic heart.
activities.tip: Stop at Paulina Falls on the way in — a quick, rewarding hike.

activities.title: Sunriver Stargazing
activities.imageAlt: Starry night sky over a dark landscape
activities.description: Sunriver's dark skies are among the best in Oregon. Step onto the back deck after dark — the Milky Way on a clear moonless night will stop you in your tracks.
activities.tip: New moon weeks are best. Turn off deck lights for 10 minutes, or catch a summer night viewing at the Oregon Observatory at the Sunriver Nature Center.

activities.title: Woodlands Golf Course
activities.imageAlt: Golf course fairway lined with pine trees
activities.description: Our home sits between the 1st and 10th holes — stroll to the clubhouse or driving range in minutes. A classic Central Oregon course through ponderosa pine.
activities.tip: McDivot's Cafe at the clubhouse is perfect for a post-round drink.

activities.title: Crosswater Club
activities.imageAlt: Scenic golf course with mountain backdrop
activities.description: A world-renowned golf course designed by Peter Jacobsen and Jim Hardy — two courses ranked among the best in the Pacific Northwest. Public tee times available.
activities.tip: Book well ahead — this is a bucket-list course.

activities.title: Sunriver Stables
activities.imageAlt: Horseback riding on a forest trail
activities.description: Guided trail rides through the pines for all experience levels, plus pony rides for little ones. A memorable family outing in any season.
activities.tip: Book the sunset ride for golden light through the trees.

activities.title: The Village at Sunriver
activities.imageAlt: Forest village with shops and pathways
activities.description: The heart of Sunriver — shops, restaurants, an ice rink in winter, live music in summer, and events year-round. A five-minute bike ride from the house.
activities.tip: Check the events calendar for concerts and festivals.
